title: Grey stone
hint: Grey streaks run through the mine walls. Dig one out with mine().
text: The mountain's bones. Every wall in Hollowmere is built from it, and the Quarry cuts more from the hillside.

title: Iron ore
hint: Some walls glow rusty orange. What's inside?
text: Rusty rock that melts into iron in a hot enough furnace. The Smelter needs heat 5 or more.

title: Old timber
hint: The old miners propped up their tunnels with beams. Are any still good?
text: Seasoned beams from the old mine props. Dry wood burns hot in the Smelter and the Bakery.

title: Mine crystal
hint: Deep in the mines, something in the walls glitters blue.
text: Clear blue crystal that hums with arcane power. The Arcane Tower and the Greenhouse want it.

title: Monster essence
hint: What do monsters leave behind when they fall?
text: A faint glowing dust in monster remains. Golems pick it up when they walk over the remains; spells and rune cores feed on it.

title: Iron bars
hint: Smelt some ore in the Smelter.
text: Plates, hammers and lanterns: the Forge turns iron into equipment for your golems.

title: Fresh bread
hint: Bake a batch at the Bakery.
text: Townsfolk won't move back without it. The Market, the Cottages and the Guild Hall need bread.

title: Pumpkins
hint: The farm drone can grow more than wheat.
text: Big, orange and oddly popular at the Harvest Tavern.

title: Spike trap
hint: Some floor tiles are not what they seem.
text: Spikes shoot up for 6 damage. sense_ahead() reveals a trap on the next tile before you step on it, and golems path around traps they know about.

title: Fire vent
hint: The deeper tunnels are warm. Why?
text: A jet of flame sets a golem burning. An on status handler can react to it.

title: Snare
hint: Old poachers' rope still lies in the dark.
text: A rope loop that slows a golem for 4 seconds.

title: Up the chimney
hint: What happens if you stoke a furnace that's already hot?
text: Heat above 10 is wasted, and so is the wood that made it. Check heat() before you stoke().

title: Cold furnace
hint: Try to smelt without stoking first.
text: Ore only melts at heat 5 or more, and the furnace cools by 1 every tick you don't stoke it.

title: Doughy middle
hint: Impatient bakers find this one.
text: Bread taken out before 4 ticks goes back to the dough pile. Nothing is lost but time.

title: Charcoal loaves
hint: Forgetful bakers find this one.
text: After 7 ticks in a burning oven, bread burns and is lost. baked() tells you how long it's been in.

title: A full tray
hint: The oven holds more than two loaves.
text: Four loaves bake as fast as one. Knead 4 dough before you bake().

title: Green harvest
hint: What happens if the drone harvests too soon?
text: Unripe crops are lost. if can_harvest(): harvest() keeps them safe.

title: Rotten pumpkin
hint: Not every pumpkin makes it.
text: One pumpkin in five rots as it ripens. harvest() clears it, then plant() a new one.

title: The great patch
hint: Pumpkins like company.
text: Four or more ripe pumpkins touching each other come in as one patch: n pumpkins give n × min(n, 3).

title: The Mine Entrance
hint: Reach the stairs at the Mine Entrance.
text: Three chests, no monsters, and veins of every common kind. Every golem's first delve.

title: The first floor
hint: Reach the stairs on the Old Mines' first floor.
text: Slimes, skeletons and one spike trap: the first floor where code has to decide.

title: The Old Mines
hint: Clear the Old Mines 5 times.
text: No two floors are alike. Programs that explore() and decide survive; fixed routes don't.

title: The Deep Mines
hint: Reach the stairs in the Deep Mines.
text: Trolls, spiders and crystal. The deepest place anyone from Hollowmere has been in a hundred years.

title: First commission
hint: Finish a commission from the notice board.
text: The valley has noticed Hollowmere's workshops. Faster, shorter scripts earn medals.
